alignments.note: Anarthrous substantival adjective with the determiner the ASV supplies to make it a noun phrase, headed on the lexeme-bearing word (rule 46).

Bare nominal recast as a prepositional phrase; the supplied of states what this nominal contributes and belongs to it (rule 33).
